panelSpecification.concreteGenerationSpecification: Restage all FOUR canonical crew in a candid tense bridge investigation with distinct roles, not a front-facing line. Farah seated at a compact angled main work console points a stylus to the reconstruction row, eyebrows drawn. Demir seated adjacent saves the capture on a small control, eyes intent on it. Nazari stands at one side with a lowered tablet whose back faces camera and questions Farah with skeptical gaze. Mirza leans one hand on the rail behind and turns three-quarter toward Farah with a firm questioning expression, other hand relaxed. All four faces naturally visible, no direct camera gaze, no broad smiles, eight anatomically connected arms with clear shoulder origins and believable supports. Main monitor faces Farah/Demir and shows two-column status comparison headed Archive7741 and Live capture, with rows Amplitude:quiet/quiet; Autoencoder:flag/flag; LSTM:flag/flag; Votes:2/2. A small side monitor near Demir shows Live capture,73.4Hz,Reconstruction:12x highest normal,Raw capture retained,Cause unresolved. No arbitrary waveforms, bars or lesson poster. Screens physically angled for the working crew, text baselines and grids share each screen plane. Camera near the crew side of consoles, never make them read a reversed screen. Other monitors and holo emitter inactive. Moderate warm stylized adult proportions, restrained sage and brass, no fluorescent green rims.
